headline: Lamps learn the table first.
body: The glass still holds a thumbprint from the afternoon. Outside, a bus sighs at the corner and does not linger. We keep the radio low enough that the kettle can finish its sentence.

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: amber on the spine of a closed notebook

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the quiet after a long errand

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet kerb, one umbrella already folded
